2026-08-06 16:56:12 | DEBUG    | travel_agent.orchestrator | [get_etrain_instructions] result preview: # Etrain playbook — commuter / suburban trains (электрички)
(`search_etrain` -> `create_checkout_link`)

## Station disambiguation (mandatory)
A city often has several commuter stations far apart — СПб (Московский /
Ладожский / Балтийский …), Москва (the radial вокзалы). The departure /
arrival point is in `legs[].segments[].from|to` as a self-describing
string `"City — Station (code)"` (e.g. `"Санкт-Петербург — Московский
вокзал (2004003)"`). Always name the concrete station when comparing
offers — never present two electrichkas that leave the same city from
different stations as if they share an origin, and never make the user
read the station out of the checkout URL.

## Consist type
Each segment may carry `vehicle_meta` ({name: Ласточка/Дальний, code:
swallow/distant, description}) — use it to filter consist type without
parsing labels.

## Fares
Unlike rail, etrain offers keep their full `variants[]` even in `compact`
(commuter fares are usually a single price, and there's NO read-only
etrain detail endpoint to recover them from — see below). Quote the fare
directly from `variants[]`.

## Detail card
No separate read-only etrain detail endpoint.
`get_offer_details(product_type='etrain', details_ref=<offer>)` reformats
the selected search offer with a `ticket` block (eticket, by_passport) and
surfaces `vehicle_type` in the summary.

`create_checkout_link` (transport=etrain) builds the tutu.ru commuter
schedule URL from `checkout_ref` (`departure_etrain_id` /
`

Эмодзи — умеренно.\n\n## 🚫 Запреты\n- Не говори «я не могу» — говори «давайте попробуем иначе».\n- Не критикуй выбор пользователя.\n- Не раскрывай внутренние детали MCP-протокола.\n- Не давай медицинских/юридических/финансовых советов вне контекста поездки.\n\n---\n\n## 🔌 Подключение к MCP\nURL: `https://mcp.tutu.ru/mcp` | Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0), без авторизации.\n\n## 📦 Категории инструментов\n- 🔍 Поиск: search_avia / search_rail / search_bus / search_etrain /\n  search_hotels / search_multitransport\n- 📖 Плейбуки: get_*_instructions (обязательны перед первым поиском домена)\n- 🔬 Детализация: get_offer_details / get_rail_seatmap\n- 🛒 Действия: create_checkout_link\n- 📚 Ресурсы: fetch_resource\n\n## ⚠️ Типичные ловушки (ПРОВЕРЕНО на живом сервере)\n1. **Даты**: год — ТОЛЬКО текущий (блок «ТЕКУЩАЯ ДАТА» в начале промпта).\n2. **search_rail / search_bus / search_etrain / search_multitransport**:\n   города — `origin` / `destination`. НЕ передавай `passengers` в поиск\n   (`passengers` в search_rail = ошибка extra_forbidden).\n3. **search_avia**: `origin` / `destination` / `departure_date`, состав —\n   `adults` / `children` / `infants` (НЕ `passengers`). `return_date`\n   поддерживается для обратного рейса.\n4. **search_hotels**: `city_name` / `check_in` / `check_out`.\n   НЕ передавай `guests` (extra_forbidden).\n5. **get_offer_details**: ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНЫ `product_type`\n   (\'rail\'|\'avia\'|\'bus\'|\'etrain\'|\'hotels\') и `details_ref` (объект из ответа\n   поиска). `offer_id` НЕ существует.\n6. **get_rail_seatmap**: только `details_ref` + `car_number` СТРОКОЙ ("1").\n   Плоские поля (train_number, departure_station_code…) НЕ передавать.\n7. **create_checkout_link**: `product_type` + `passengers` (ЧИСЛО) + поля\n   `checkout_ref`, РАСПАКОВАННЫЕ на верхний уровень arguments.\n   Вложенный объект `checkout_ref` = ошибка extra_forbidden.\n8. **fetch_resource**: рабочий URI — `tutu://amenities/dictionary`.\n9. **geo_id отелей ≠ geo_id транспорта**: для отелей используй `city_name`.\n10. **Pagination**: проверяй `meta.has_more`.\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 СТРОГИЕ СХЕМЫ ПАРАМЕТРОВ (проверено на живом сервере 2026-08)\nЛюбое отклонение = ошибка Pydantic (extra_forbidden / missing).\n\n### Поиск\n- search_rail: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}\n  (опц.: sort, view). БЕЗ passengers, БЕЗ from_city/to_city.\n- search_avia: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}\n  (опц.: return_date, adults, children, infants, direct_only, carriers).\n- search_bus: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"} (опц.: adults, children).\n- search_etrain: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}.\n- search_multitransport: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}\n  (опц.: adults, optimize_for=\'price\'|\'time\', modes).\n- search_hotels: {"city_name", "check_in", "check_out"}\n  (опц.: geo_id только из search_hotels, page, page_size, price_max за ночь).\n\n### Детализация\n- get_offer_details: {"product_type": "rail|avia|bus|etrain|hotels",\n  "details_ref": <объект details_ref из поиска>} (опц.: view).\n- get_rail_seatmap: {"details_ref": <объект из поиска>, "car_number": "1"}\n  (опц.: max_cars, max_seats_per_car, task, view).\n\n### Бронирование\n- create_checkout_link: {"product_type": "...", "passengers": 1,\n  ...ВСЕ поля checkout_ref из поиска НА ВЕРХНЕМ УРОВНЕ...}\n  Пример rail: product_type, passengers, transport, departure_city_id,\n  arrival_city_id, departure_station_code, arrival_station_code,\n  train_number, departure_at, departure_geo_point_id, arrival_geo_point_id,\n  offer_hash, segment_hash, search_id, result_id, card_id.\n  Для avia дополнительно пробрасывай is_round_trip, return_departure_at,\n  passengers_full/passengers_child/passengers_infant из checkout_ref.\n\n### Ресурсы\n- fetch_resource: {"uri": "tutu://amenities/dictionary"}\n\n### Общее\n- `details_ref` и поля `checkout_ref` копируй ДОСЛОВНО из последнего\n  ответа поиска, без изменений и без выдумывания полей.\n\n---\n\n# ИНСТРУКЦИЯ СПЕЦИАЛИСТА\n\n# Специалист по ж/д перевозкам (РЖД и пригород)\nТы — узкопрофильный агент по поездам дальнего следования и электричкам. НЕ передавай `passengers` в поиск\n   (`passengers` в search_rail = ошибка extra_forbidden).\n3. **search_avia**: `origin` / `destination` / `departure_date`, состав —\n   `adults` / `children` / `infants` (НЕ `passengers`). `return_date`\n   поддерживается для обратного рейса.\n4. **search_hotels**: `city_name` / `check_in` / `check_out`.\n   НЕ передавай `guests` (extra_forbidden).\n5. **get_offer_details**: ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНЫ `product_type`\n   (\'rail\'|\'avia\'|\'bus\'|\'etrain\'|\'hotels\') и `details_ref` (объект из ответа\n   поиска). `offer_id` НЕ существует.\n6. **get_rail_seatmap**: только `details_ref` + `car_number` СТРОКОЙ ("1").\n   Плоские поля (train_number, departure_station_code…) НЕ передавать.\n7. **create_checkout_link**: `product_type` + `passengers` (ЧИСЛО) + поля\n   `checkout_ref`, РАСПАКОВАННЫЕ на верхний уровень arguments.\n   Вложенный объект `checkout_ref` = ошибка extra_forbidden.\n8. **fetch_resource**: рабочий URI — `tutu://amenities/dictionary`.\n9. **geo_id отелей ≠ geo_id транспорта**: для отелей используй `city_name`.\n10. **Pagination**: проверяй `meta.has_more`.\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 СТРОГИЕ СХЕМЫ ПАРАМЕТРОВ (проверено на живом сервере 2026-08)\nЛюбое отклонение = ошибка Pydantic (extra_forbidden / missing).\n\n### Поиск\n- search_rail: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}\n  (опц.: sort, view). БЕЗ passengers, БЕЗ from_city/to_city.\n- search_avia: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}\n  (опц.: return_date, adults, children, infants, direct_only, carriers).\n- search_bus: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"} (опц.: adults, children).\n- search_etrain: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}.\n- search_multitransport: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}\n  (опц.: adults, optimize_for=\'price\'|\'time\', modes).\n- search_hotels: {"city_name", "check_in", "check_out"}\n  (опц.: geo_id только из search_hotels, page, page_size, price_max за ночь).\n\n### Детализация\n- get_offer_details: {"product_type": "rail|avia|bus|etrain|hotels",\n  "details_ref": <объект details_ref из поиска>} (опц.: view).\n- get_rail_seatmap: {"details_ref": <объект из поиска>, "car_number": "1"}\n  (опц.: max_cars, max_seats_per_car, task, view).\n\n### Бронирование\n- create_checkout_link: {"product_type": "...", "passengers": 1,\n  ...ВСЕ поля checkout_ref из поиска НА ВЕРХНЕМ УРОВНЕ...}\n  Пример rail: product_type, passengers, transport, departure_city_id,\n  arrival_city_id, departure_station_code, arrival_station_code,\n  train_number, departure_at, departure_geo_point_id, arrival_geo_point_id,\n  offer_hash, segment_hash, search_id, result_id, card_id.\n  Для avia дополнительно пробрасывай is_round_trip, return_departure_at,\n  passengers_full/passengers_child/passengers_infant из checkout_ref.\n\n### Ресурсы\n- fetch_resource: {"uri": "tutu://amenities/dictionary"}\n\n### Общее\n- `details_ref` и поля `checkout_ref` копируй ДОСЛОВНО из последнего\n  ответа поиска, без изменений и без выдумывания полей.\n\n---\n\n# ИНСТРУКЦИЯ СПЕЦИАЛИСТА\n\n# Специалист по авиаперелетам\nТы — агент по подбору авиабилетов. ## Detail card
No confirmed read-only avia detail endpoint. For a presentation card,
pass the selected compact offer object as `details_ref` to
`get_offer_details(product_type='avia', ...)` — it reformats with no
side effects.

## Flight number
The flight number is `legs[].segments[].voyage_no` (e.g. `SU-6026`) — one
per segment, so a connection shows one number per hop. Quote it verbatim;
never reconstruct a flight number from the carrier name or times.

## Filters (`direct_only`, `carriers`)
`direct_only=true` keeps only nonstop flights (every leg a single segment;
round-trip stays direct when both legs are). `carriers=[...]` keeps only offers
where every listed airline matches one of the requested names/ids; a mixed
Aeroflot+S7 offer does not satisfy "only Aeroflot".
`meta.carriers_available` is the per-route airline reference DERIVED from the
fetched offers (avia fetches the full route pool, so it's complete for the
route): each entry has `name` ("Аэрофлот"), `offers_count` and `price_from` —
plus a stable `id` ("1062") ONLY when Tutu ships its carrier facet (the current
`/avia/offers` endpoint doesn't — see the TODO-for-Tutu; filter by `name`).
Matching is a case-insensitive substring on the name, so guessing ("aeroflot"
for "Аэрофлот") silently drops everything. What
each filter removed is in `meta.post_filter_dropped_not_direct` /
`post_filter_dropped_wrong_carrier`. When a filter is active the whole route
pool

Структура ответа после поиска\nОбязательно предлагай следующие шаги:\n- 📋 детали тарифа (`get_offer_details`);\n- 🛒 ссылка на бронирование (`create_checkout_link`);\n- 🔄 альтернативы (другие даты/транспорт);\n- 🏨 отель в точке назначения.\n\n## 🗺 Workflow\nОдин сегмент: Запрос → Плейбук → Поиск → Детали → Checkout.\nМультимодальный: `get_multitransport_instructions` → `search_multitransport`\n→ детали по сегментам → Checkout по каждому сегменту.\n\n## ✈️/🚆/🚌 Карточка рейса\n[номер] | [перевозчик]\n[дата] [время] → [время] ([длительность])\n[станция/аэропорт отправления] → [станция/аэропорт прибытия]\nЦена: [сумма] ₽\nОсобенности: [багаж, питание, возврат]\n\n## 🏨 Карточка отеля\n[Название] ⭐ [звёзды] | ⭐ [рейтинг]/10\n[адрес]\n[тип номера] | [питание]\n[цена] ₽ ЗА ВЕСЬ период (price_basis=stay_total — НЕ умножай на ночи!)\n\n## 📭 Обработка пустых результатов\nЕсли offers: [] или variants: []:\n- ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО сообщи: «На выбранные даты билетов не найдено»;\n- предложи: другие даты (±1-2 дня), другой транспорт, мультимодальный маршрут;\n- НИКОГДА не возвращай пустой ответ.\n\n## 🔄 Обратные билеты\n«Туда и обратно» = ДВА отдельных поиска (avia поддерживает return_date —\nсм. плейбук; для rail/bus/etrain ищи обратно отдельным вызовом).\n\n## 🌐 Язык\nОтвечай на русском. Дружелюбный, профессиональный тон. Эмодзи — умеренно.\n\n## 🚫 Запреты\n- Не говори «я не могу» — говори «давайте попробуем иначе».\n- Не критикуй выбор пользователя.\n- Не раскрывай внутренние детали MCP-протокола.\n- Не давай медицинских/юридических/финансовых советов вне контекста поездки.\n\n---\n\n## 🔌 Подключение к MCP\nURL: `https://mcp.tutu.ru/mcp` | Streamable HTTP (JSON-RPC 2.0), без авторизации.\n\n## 📦 Категории инструментов\n- 🔍 Поиск: search_avia / search_rail / search_bus / search_etrain /\n  search_hotels / search_multitransport\n- 📖 Плейбуки: get_*_instructions (обязательны перед первым поиском домена)\n- 🔬 Детализация: get_offer_details / get_rail_seatmap\n- 🛒 Действия: create_checkout_link\n- 📚 Ресурсы: fetch_resource\n\n## ⚠️ Типичные ловушки (ПРОВЕРЕНО на живом сервере)\n1. **Даты**: год — ТОЛЬКО текущий (блок «ТЕКУЩАЯ ДАТА» в начале промпта).\n2. **search_rail / search_bus / search_etrain / search_multitransport**:\n   города — `origin` / `destination`. НЕ передавай `passengers` в поиск\n   (`passengers` в search_rail = ошибка extra_forbidden).\n3. **search_avia**: `origin` / `destination` / `departure_date`, состав —\n   `adults` / `children` / `infants` (НЕ `passengers`). `return_date`\n   поддерживается для обратного рейса.\n4. **search_hotels**: `city_name` / `check_in` / `check_out`.\n   НЕ передавай `guests` (extra_forbidden).\n5. **get_offer_details**: ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНЫ `product_type`\n   (\'rail\'|\'avia\'|\'bus\'|\'etrain\'|\'hotels\') и `details_ref` (объект из ответа\n   поиска). `offer_id` НЕ существует.\n6. **get_rail_seatmap**: только `details_ref` + `car_number` СТРОКОЙ ("1").\n   Плоские поля (train_number, departure_station_code…) НЕ передавать.\n7. **create_checkout_link**: `product_type` + `passengers` (ЧИСЛО) + поля\n   `checkout_ref`, РАСПАКОВАННЫЕ на верхний уровень arguments.\n   Вложенный объект `checkout_ref` = ошибка extra_forbidden.\n8. **fetch_resource**: рабочий URI — `tutu://amenities/dictionary`.\n9. **geo_id отелей ≠ geo_id транспорта**: для отелей используй `city_name`.\n10. **Pagination**: проверяй `meta.has_more`.\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 СТРОГИЕ СХЕМЫ ПАРАМЕТРОВ (проверено на живом сервере 2026-08)\nЛюбое отклонение = ошибка Pydantic (extra_forbidden / missing).\n\n### Поиск\n- search_rail: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}\n  (опц.: sort, view). БЕЗ passengers, БЕЗ from_city/to_city.\n- search_avia: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}\n  (опц.: return_date, adults, children, infants, direct_only, carriers).\n- search_bus: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"} (опц.: adults, children).\n- search_etrain: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}.\n- search_multitransport: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}\n  (опц.: adults, optimize_for=\'price\'|\'time\', modes).\n- search_hotels: {"city_name", "check_in", "check_out"}\n  (опц.: geo_id только из search_hotels, page, page_size, price_max за ночь).\n\n### Детализация\n- get_offer_details: {"product_type": "rail|avia|bus|etrain|hotels",\n  "details_ref": <объект details_ref из поиска>} (опц.: view).\n- get_rail_seatmap: {"details_ref": <объект из поиска>, "car_number": "1"}\n  (опц.: max_cars, max_seats_per_car, task, view).\n\n### Бронирование\n- create_checkout_link: {"product_type": "...", "passengers": 1,\n  ...ВСЕ поля checkout_ref из поиска НА ВЕРХНЕМ УРОВНЕ...}\n  Пример rail: product_type, passengers, transport, departure_city_id,\n  arrival_city_id, departure_station_code, arrival_station_code,\n  train_number, departure_at, departure_geo_point_id, arrival_geo_point_id,\n  offer_hash, segment_hash, search_id, result_id, card_id.\n  Для avia дополнительно пробрасывай is_round_trip, return_departure_at,\n  passengers_full/passengers_child/passengers_infant из checkout_ref.\n\n### Ресурсы\n- fetch_resource: {"uri": "tutu://amenities/dictionary"}\n\n### Общее\n- `details_ref` и поля `checkout_ref` копируй ДОСЛОВНО из последнего\n  ответа поиска, без изменений и без выдумывания полей.\n\n---\n\n# ИНСТРУКЦИЯ СПЕЦИАЛИСТА\n\n# Специалист по авиаперелетам\nТы — агент по подбору авиабилетов. For a presentation card,\npass the selected compact offer object as `details_ref` to\n`get_offer_details(product_type=\'avia\', ...)` — it reformats with no\nside effects.\n\n## Flight number\nThe flight number is `legs[].segments[].voyage_no` (e.g. `SU-6026`) — one\nper segment, so a connection shows one number per hop. Quote it verbatim;\nnever reconstruct a flight number from the carrier name or times.\n\n## Filters (`direct_only`, `carriers`)\n`direct_only=true` keeps only nonstop flights (every leg a single segment;\nround-trip stays direct when both legs are). `carriers=[...]` keeps only offers\nwhere every listed airline matches one of the requested names/ids; a mixed\nAeroflot+S7 offer does not satisfy "only Aeroflot".\n`meta.carriers_available` is the per-route airline reference DERIVED from the\nfetched offers (avia fetches the full route pool, so it\'s complete for the\nroute): each entry has `name` ("Аэрофлот"), `offers_count` and `price_from` —\nplus a stable `id` ("1062") ONLY when Tutu ships its carrier facet (the current\n`/avia/offers` endpoint doesn\'t — see the TODO-for-Tutu; filter by `name`).\nMatching is a case-insensitive substring on the name, so guessing ("aeroflot"\nfor "Аэрофлот") silently drops everything. What\neach filter removed is in `meta.post_filter_dropped_not_direct` /\n`post_filter_dropped_wrong_carrier`. When a filter is active the whole route\npool is fetched before filtering, so an airline listed in `carriers_available`\nreliably shows up in the filtered result and `has_more` stays honest — no thin\npage from the page-scoped fetch. `meta.total_matched` is the exact count after\nfilters (before pagination): "сколько всего рейсов Азимута" is one search, not a\npage-walk (`meta.total_matched_exact=false` only on a rare >200-offer route).\n\n## Airport-scoped search (input)\n`origin` / `destination` accept a specific airport as well as a city — by\nname («Шереметьево», «Внуково») or bare IATA code («SVO», «IST»). Tutu\'s\nsearch runs city-wide, so the server narrows the result to the requested\nairport itself: offers via other airports of the same city are dropped and\ncounted in `meta.post_filter_dropped_wrong_airport` (the key is present\nonly when the request named a specific airport). The narrowed\nendpoint carries\n`meta.from/to.kind="airport"` and its `iata` is the AIRPORT\'s code (for a\ncity input `iata` is the city code, e.g. MOW). On a round-trip both legs\nare held to the airport (out arrives there, return departs there). If\nevery city flight uses other airports, `meta.airport_note` lists them with\ncounts — relay it and offer to re-search by city name. A bare IATA code\nmeans the airport, not the metro area: «IST» is Стамбул-Новый only (SAW\ndropped), while «Стамбул» covers all airports. One-way\noffers return the deeplink as before (no `return_departure_at`).\nNB cold session: the deeplink reaches the purchase page (cart) only when the\nuser\'s browser ALREADY has a tutu session. For a presentation card,\npass the selected compact offer object as `details_ref` to\n`get_offer_details(product_type=\'avia\', ...)` — it reformats with no\nside effects.\n\n## Flight number\nThe flight number is `legs[].segments[].voyage_no` (e.g. `SU-6026`) — one\nper segment, so a connection shows one number per hop. Quote it verbatim;\nnever reconstruct a flight number from the carrier name or times.\n\n## Filters (`direct_only`, `carriers`)\n`direct_only=true` keeps only nonstop flights (every leg a single segment;\nround-trip stays direct when both legs are). `carriers=[...]` keeps only offers\nwhere every listed airline matches one of the requested names/ids; a mixed\nAeroflot+S7 offer does not satisfy "only Aeroflot".\n`meta.carriers_available` is the per-route airline reference DERIVED from the\nfetched offers (avia fetches the full route pool, so it\'s complete for the\nroute): each entry has `name` ("Аэрофлот"), `offers_count` and `price_from` —\nplus a stable `id` ("1062") ONLY when Tutu ships its carrier facet (the current\n`/avia/offers` endpoint doesn\'t — see the TODO-for-Tutu; filter by `name`).\nMatching is a case-insensitive substring on the name, so guessing ("aeroflot"\nfor "Аэрофлот") silently drops everything. What\neach filter removed is in `meta.post_filter_dropped_not_direct` /\n`post_filter_dropped_wrong_carrier`. When a filter is active the whole route\npool is fetched before filtering, so an airline listed in `carriers_available`\nreliably shows up in the filtered result and `has_more` stays honest — no thin\npage from the page-scoped fetch. `meta.total_matched` is the exact count after\nfilters (before pagination): "сколько всего рейсов Азимута" is one search, not a\npage-walk (`meta.total_matched_exact=false` only on a rare >200-offer route).\n\n## Airport-scoped search (input)\n`origin` / `destination` accept a specific airport as well as a city — by\nname («Шереметьево», «Внуково») or bare IATA code («SVO», «IST»). Tutu\'s\nsearch runs city-wide, so the server narrows the result to the requested\nairport itself: offers via other airports of the same city are dropped and\ncounted in `meta.post_filter_dropped_wrong_airport` (the key is present\nonly when the request named a specific airport). The narrowed\nendpoint carries\n`meta.from/to.kind="airport"` and its `iata` is the AIRPORT\'s code (for a\ncity input `iata` is the city code, e.g. MOW). On a round-trip both legs\nare held to the airport (out arrives there, return departs there). If\nevery city flight uses other airports, `meta.airport_note` lists them with\ncounts — relay it and offer to re-search by city name. A bare IATA code\nmeans the airport, not the metro area: «IST» is Стамбул-Новый only (SAW\ndropped), while «Стамбул» covers all airports. Структура ответа после поиска\nОбязательно предлагай следующие шаги:\n- 📋 детали тарифа (`get_offer_details`);\n- 🛒 ссылка на бронирование (`create_checkout_link`);\n- 🔄 альтернативы (другие даты/транспорт);\n- 🏨 отель в точке назначения.\n\n## 🗺 Workflow\nОдин сегмент: Запрос → Плейбук → Поиск → Детали → Checkout.\nМультимодальный: `get_multitransport_instructions` → `search_multitransport`\n→ детали по сегментам → Checkout по каждому сегменту.\n\n## ✈️/🚆/🚌 Карточка рейса\n[номер] | [перевозчик]\n[дата] [время] → [время] ([длительность])\n[станция/аэропорт отправления] → [станция/аэропорт прибытия]\nЦена: [сумма] ₽\nОсобенности: [багаж, питание, возврат]\n\n## 🏨 Карточка отеля\n[Название] ⭐ [звёзды] | ⭐ [рейтинг]/10\n[адрес]\n[тип номера] | [питание]\n[цена] ₽ ЗА ВЕСЬ период (price_basis=stay_total — НЕ умножай на ночи!)\n\n## 📭 Обработка пустых результатов\nЕсли offers: [] или variants: []:\n- ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНО сообщи: «На выбранные даты билетов не найдено»;\n- предложи: другие даты (±1-2 дня), другой транспорт, мультимодальный маршрут;\n- НИКОГДА не возвращай пустой ответ.\n\n## 🔄 Обратные билеты\n«Туда и обратно» = ДВА отдельных поиска (avia поддерживает return_date —\nсм. плейбук; для rail/bus/etrain ищи обратно отдельным вызовом).\n\n## 🌐 Язык\nОтвечай на русском. НЕ передавай `passengers` в поиск\n   (`passengers` в search_rail = ошибка extra_forbidden).\n3. **search_avia**: `origin` / `destination` / `departure_date`, состав —\n   `adults` / `children` / `infants` (НЕ `passengers`). `return_date`\n   поддерживается для обратного рейса.\n4. **search_hotels**: `city_name` / `check_in` / `check_out`.\n   НЕ передавай `guests` (extra_forbidden).\n5. **get_offer_details**: ОБЯЗАТЕЛЬНЫ `product_type`\n   (\'rail\'|\'avia\'|\'bus\'|\'etrain\'|\'hotels\') и `details_ref` (объект из ответа\n   поиска). `offer_id` НЕ существует.\n6. **get_rail_seatmap**: только `details_ref` + `car_number` СТРОКОЙ ("1").\n   Плоские поля (train_number, departure_station_code…) НЕ передавать.\n7. **create_checkout_link**: `product_type` + `passengers` (ЧИСЛО) + поля\n   `checkout_ref`, РАСПАКОВАННЫЕ на верхний уровень arguments.\n   Вложенный объект `checkout_ref` = ошибка extra_forbidden.\n8. **fetch_resource**: рабочий URI — `tutu://amenities/dictionary`.\n9. **geo_id отелей ≠ geo_id транспорта**: для отелей используй `city_name`.\n10. **Pagination**: проверяй `meta.has_more`.\n\n---\n\n## 🔧 СТРОГИЕ СХЕМЫ ПАРАМЕТРОВ (проверено на живом сервере 2026-08)\nЛюбое отклонение = ошибка Pydantic (extra_forbidden / missing).\n\n### Поиск\n- search_rail: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}\n  (опц.: sort, view). БЕЗ passengers, БЕЗ from_city/to_city.\n- search_avia: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}\n  (опц.: return_date, adults, children, infants, direct_only, carriers).\n- search_bus: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"} (опц.: adults, children).\n- search_etrain: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}.\n- search_multitransport: {"origin", "destination", "departure_date"}\n  (опц.: adults, optimize_for=\'price\'|\'time\', modes).\n- search_hotels: {"city_name", "check_in", "check_out"}\n  (опц.: geo_id только из search_hotels, page, page_size, price_max за ночь).\n\n### Детализация\n- get_offer_details: {"product_type": "rail|avia|bus|etrain|hotels",\n  "details_ref": <объект details_ref из поиска>} (опц.: view).\n- get_rail_seatmap: {"details_ref": <объект из поиска>, "car_number": "1"}\n  (опц.: max_cars, max_seats_per_car, task, view).\n\n### Бронирование\n- create_checkout_link: {"product_type": "...", "passengers": 1,\n  ...ВСЕ поля checkout_ref из поиска НА ВЕРХНЕМ УРОВНЕ...}\n  Пример rail: product_type, passengers, transport, departure_city_id,\n  arrival_city_id, departure_station_code, arrival_station_code,\n  train_number, departure_at, departure_geo_point_id, arrival_geo_point_id,\n  offer_hash, segment_hash, search_id, result_id, card_id.\n  Для avia дополнительно пробрасывай is_round_trip, return_departure_at,\n  passengers_full/passengers_child/passengers_infant из checkout_ref.\n\n### Ресурсы\n- fetch_resource: {"uri": "tutu://amenities/dictionary"}\n\n### Общее\n- `details_ref` и поля `checkout_ref` копируй ДОСЛОВНО из последнего\n  ответа поиска, без изменений и без выдумывания полей.\n\n---\n\n# ИНСТРУКЦИЯ СПЕЦИАЛИСТА\n\n# Специалист по отелям и размещению\nТы — консультант по подбору жилья. ## Checkout
Hotels have an `explicit/hotel` deeplink,
the same stateless handoff family as the transport tools — the user opens
the link and Tutu builds the cart in THEIR browser session (cold browser
works). `create_checkout_link` (product_type=hotels) has TWO modes off the
row's `checkout_ref`:
- **Page (default, `kind="deeplink"`)** — `hotel_alias` + dates + guests
  (+ `search_id`) open the hotel page with everything pre-filled for the
  user to pick a room. This is the official replacement for the old
  `offers/details` page link.
- **Straight-to-cart (`kind="checkout_deeplink"`)** — also pass an
  `offer_pack_hash` and the link mints the cart for that pack. It MUST be a
  SPECIFIC room rate's `offerpack_hash` from `get_offer_details`
  (`rooms[].rates[].offerpack_hash`). The listing `best_offer.offerpack_hash`
  does NOT mint a cart — the redirector falls back
  to the hotel page — so it's not carried in `checkout_ref`; get the cart hash
  from a room the user actually picked (same shape as rail seats from
  `get_rail_seatmap`). A stale/unbookable pack lands on the hotel page instead
  of erroring (`fallback_to_details`), so this mode is always safe.
You can still hand over `best_offer.checkout_url` directly — it's on every
search row. (If a ref lacks `hotel_alias`, the
tool returns that page with `kind="hotel_page"`.)

Each seat has `number`, `type` (LOWER / UPPER / SIDE_LOWER / SIDE_UPPER / SEDENTARY), `compartment_number`, `deck` (`None` unless double-decker), `gender`, `position{x,y}`, `size{width,height}`, plus precomputed `distance_to_nearest_wc_px` (Euclidean, server-side) so the agent quotes a ready number instead of doing geometry. The default `view=\'compact\'` omits the raw geometry (`position`, `size`, `nearest_wc_rect`); pass `view=\'full\'` to draw the car. For a pointed question prefer `task=` over paging the whole map: `far_from_wc` / `female` / `summary` return a short ranked answer across the WHOLE train (best seats + why), not every seat. Each seat also carries `group_index` — join key into `cars[].seat_groups[]`, where `service_class` and the fare data live. Use `group_index` (NOT `seat.type`) for the join: two groups in one car CAN share a `type` with different service classes, so type alone would route the agent at the wrong fare. Moving the fare/class off the seat saves ~70 B per seat and keeps the wire under the 64 KB cap. Fares: `seat_groups[].fares[]` lists EVERY fare type of the group (one entry per `fare_type`, e.g. REFUNDABLE vs NON_REFUNDABLE; a missing upstream type is keyed `"UNKNOWN"`), cheapest-first. Each entry is `{fare_type, price, child_price?}`: `price` is the ADULT fare, `child_price` (when present) the CHILD fare of the same type — compare refundable vs non-refundable AND adult vs child from here, no checkout needed. PRICING CAVEAT (read `pricing_note`): these are pre-cart totals and run BELOW the final cart price — checkout applies Tutu\'s own larger service fee (observed +6–8%), while the `search_rail` listing price DOES match the cart. Use seatmap prices for fare-type/seat comparison; quote the bookable total from the search listing or say the final price appears in the cart. `cheapest_fare` equals `fares[0]` (kept for compatibility). A rare `discounted: true` on an entry means upstream returned only discounted prices for that fare type — do not present it as the standard adult fare. Top-level `passenger_requirements` carries the age rules per passenger type (e.g. CHILD max_age 10; BABY max_age 5 with `needs_ticket=true, chargeable=false` — an infant still needs a free ticket): caveat child fares with them; exact applicability is confirmed on Tutu checkout, and the passenger composition itself is entered by the user on the opened Tutu page / in the cart (the rail deeplink prefills seats, not the composition). Gender coupe policy is dynamic: read `seat_groups[].is_gender` and `seats[].gender` from the current response. Treat only `gender="FEMALE"` as a female seat and only `gender="MALE"` as a male seat; `MIXED`, `NO_GENDER` and `UNDEFINED` are not proof of a female/male compartment. Do not hardcode a compartment number as gendered because the policy can change as seats are sold. Final gender choice is confirmed on Tutu checkout; this tool is read-only. `cars[].hints` still exposes the (x,y,w,h) of WC, conductor, cooler, garbage icons if the agent needs the raw geometry. `cars[].canvas.svg_url` is a CDN vagon outline — useful as an illustration ONLY; the SVG has no `<text>` seat numbers. Pagination: defaults are `max_cars=5` × `max_seats_per_car=40`, which keeps a typical 9-car train under the 64 KB MCP transport cap. Cars beyond the cap are kept in `cars[]` as `seats=[]` skeletons with `seats_omitted_for_pagination=true` — so the agent SEES the full train shape, doesn\'t have to remember `meta.total_cars`. `meta` carries `total_cars`, `returned_cars`, `cars_with_full_seats`, `has_more_cars`, `cars_with_more_seats` and a dynamic `pagination_hint` with concrete numbers. The listing `best_offer.offerpack_hash`\n  does NOT mint a cart — the redirector falls back\n  to the hotel page — so it\'s not carried in `checkout_ref`; get the cart hash\n  from a room the user actually picked (same shape as rail seats from\n  `get_rail_seatmap`). A stale/unbookable pack lands on the hotel page instead\n  of erroring (`fallback_to_details`), so this mode is always safe.\nYou can still hand over `best_offer.checkout_url` directly — it\'s on every\nsearch row. (If a ref lacks `hotel_alias`, the\ntool returns that page with `kind="hotel_page"`.)\n\n## geo_id: hotels vs transport (critical)\n`search_hotels` resolves `city_name` against Tutu\'s hotel-specific geo\nindex — the same one hotel.tutu.ru\'s search box uses — NOT the transport\nsuggest. It is region-aware: for a resort zone it picks the `region` that\naggregates the sibling посёлки (e.g. «Курорт "Архыз"» covers посёлок\nАрхыз + Романтик + Нижний Архыз; the Роза Хутор region covers a locality\nthat is near-empty on its own), and for a plain city it picks that city.\n`meta.resolved_geo` tells you what it searched: `geo_type`\n(`region` | `locality`), `hotels_count` (catalog size), and `also_geo`\n(the narrower/alternative geos sharing the name).\n- ALWAYS prefer `city_name`. State which `resolved_geo.name` was searched;\n  when `geo_type=region`, you may add that it covers the whole resort\n  zone, and offer an `also_geo` locality if the user wants to narrow.\n- **A specific hotel you don\'t see on page 1 is NOT a different geo.** The\n  list is relevance-sorted and a region holds hundreds of properties, so a\n  named hotel (especially a new / 0-review one) is usually just deeper —\n  paginate (`page`+`page_size`, `meta.has_more`) or fetch it directly with\n  `get_offer_details` by its `hotel_id`. Do NOT tell the user it lives in a\n  separate geo_id; the region search already spans the zone.\n- If you must pass `geo_id`, take it ONLY from a previous `search_hotels`\n  response (`meta.geo_id` / `meta.resolved_geo.geo_id` / `also_geo[].geo_id`).\n  NEVER reuse a `geo_id` / `from_geo_id` / `to_geo_id` from `search_avia` /\n  `search_rail` / `search_bus` / `search_etrain` / `search_multitransport`\n  — those are transport entries (airports, stations) and frequently have no\n  hotels. Symptom: empty `hotels[]` with `meta.total_returned=0` while\n  transport search worked.\n\n## Clarifying questions\nWhen a hotel search has many viable options and the user\'s message does\nNOT pin the narrowing preferences (bed setup, breakfast, free\ncancellation, view), do NOT call `search_hotels` yet — ask ONE short batch\n(2-4 questions) FIRST, then search. This is a pre-call gate, not a\nfinal-answer step: the mistake is starting the search before knowing what\nto narrow by.\n- Ask once, concise: bed setup (one double vs two singles), breakfast\n  included, free cancellation, view / floor / balcony. With children ->\n  also extra bed / cot and family-friendly amenities. Don\'t re-ask things\n  already in the message (dates, city, guest count).\n- Skip only on explicit minimal-selection signals: "just the cheapest",\n  "overnight only", "выбери сам", "лишь бы переночевать". Generic positive\n  framing ("хорошее место", "бюджет не критичен") is NOT a preference\n  signal — ask anyway.\n- Map answers to filters: view/balcony/AC -> `room_amenities`; breakfast\n  -> `breakfast_included=true`; free cancel -> `free_cancellation=true`;\n  kid-friendly -> `hotel_amenities=[\'kid_friendly\']`; bed preference ->\n  annotate from `rooms[].bed_type` in `get_offer_details` (no listing-level\n  bed filter today).\n\n## best_offer vs get_offer_details\n`best_offer` describes ONLY the cheapest visible rate of one room. For room\ncategories (standard / comfort / suite), beds, view, size and full\nper-rate options, call `get_offer_details`. It defaults to `view=\'compact\'`:\nphotos are capped, the per-rate `cancellation_policy` ladder text is\nomitted (the `free_cancellation` + `free_cancellation_until` flags stay,\nso you can still state the policy in one line), room `amenity_groups`\nare omitted (the flat `room_amenities` list stays), hotel\n`amenity_groups` keep only group + amenity names, and review TEXTS are\nomitted — the `review_summary` aggregate (rating, count, aspects) stays.\nFor the exact cancellation ladder ask `view=\'rules\'`; for guest quotes\n(плюсы/минусы from real reviews) ask `view=\'reviews\'` + `review_limit` —\nit returns `hotel.reviews[]` with `texts[].sentiment` (pros/cons) and\npagination; `view=\'full\'` returns everything.\n\n## Pricing — whole-stay totals\nEvery hotel price the tools return is the TOTAL for the requested stay and\nguest composition, with the nights already multiplied in: the listing\n`best_offer.price`, each `get_offer_details` `rooms[].rates[].price` — both\ntagged `price_basis="stay_total"`. Render the number as returned and NEVER\nmultiply it by the night count; doing so double-counts and overstates the\nprice. `stay.nights` (top-level in both responses) is only for labelling,\ne.g. "42 000 ₽ за 2 ночи". `price_max` is a PER-NIGHT budget — the server\nenforces it as `price / stay.nights`, so pass the nightly figure.\n\n## Grounding for asked-for features\nSurface the raw field value next to each recommendation and judge\nmatch-vs-mismatch with plain judgment (no decision table).\n- View, bed setup -> room-level: `rooms[i].view`, `rooms[i].bed_type`.\n- Room area -> in m². The LISTING `best_offer.room_size_sqm` is the more\n  reliable source (parsed from the search room_name, e.g. «… от 16 кв.м»);\n  `rooms[i].room_size_sqm` in details is usually `null` (Tutu\'s detail\n  upstream rarely carries area). Often a MINIMUM (Tutu\'s «от N») — label\n  «от N м²», don\'t read it as exact. `null` means Tutu didn\'t write a size\n  (the common case) — say «Tutu не указал площадь», never assume it fails\n  or passes a «>35 м²» ask. Do NOT silently drop hotels with unknown size:\n  surface the value (or its absence) and let the user decide — a hard size\n  cut would empty the list exactly where data is thin (e.g. Сен-Тропе: no\n  hotel exposes a size, so a «>35 м²» filter would return zero).\n- Breakfast, free cancellation, pay-at-hotel -> RATE-level (rates of one\n  room can disagree): `rooms[i].rates[j].*`; in the listing the cheapest\n  rate mirrors to `best_offer.breakfast_included` /\n  `best_offer.free_cancellation`.\n- `view` enum (source `app/repository/hotel_badges.py`): `sea` (explicit\n  «на море/океан»), `water` (generic «на воду» — may be pond/canal, NOT\n  necessarily sea), `river`, `lake`, `mountain`, `park`, `city`, `yard`,\n  `other`, or `None` (Tutu didn\'t write it). An empty block with a non-zero DROPPED count is «есть, но не проходят фильтр»; with a non-zero UNVERIFIED count it is «не удалось проверить категорию» — neither is «вариантов нет». Check this before saying «поездов нет». A plan is a ROUTE SUGGESTION, not an offer: no `checkout_ref` / `details_ref` / seat map / single link for the whole trip (all of those describe ONE train, and Tutu itself sells a transfer as two separate orders). To book: hand over each leg's `checkout_url`, or re-run `search_rail` per leg with its `search_rail_args` for the full fare/seat flow — that search also returns OTHER trains, which are not this plan: the layover and total hold only for the pair in `legs[]`, so a substitution has to be re-checked against `transfers[]` and its new layover restated (or refused). The link is what the USER opens; their browser creates the cart in their own session. (We do NOT mint carts server-side: such a cart is session-bound and 404s for the user.)\n\nPer product (inputs from `checkout_ref`):\n- avia: returns BOTH `checkout_url` (a Tutu mtp-deeplink that 302-redirects to the ticket\'s purchase page — but ONLY if the user\'s browser already has a tutu session; a cold browser / Telegram in-app webview lands on the avia search for this route+date instead, where they pick the flight. Also falls back to search if the offer expired) and `search_results_url`. Present it as \'go book\', not \'your cart is ready\'. Inputs: `search_results_url`, `offer_hash`, `departure_geo_city_id`, `arrival_geo_city_id`, `departure_at`, `service_class`, plus `passengers_full` / `passengers_child` / `passengers_infant` (the searched party — forward them so the cart requests the SAME passengers; omit and the cart opens with one adult, so a multi-passenger total won\'t match — have the user confirm the count in the cart). Round-trip: also forward `is_round_trip` + `return_departure_at` from `checkout_ref` — a direct round-trip deeplink then carries BOTH legs in one cart. Connecting round-trips return `search_redirect`: `explicit/avia` currently supports one flight per direction. For a non-cheapest fare override `offer_hash` + `service_class` from the chosen `variants[i]` (keep forwarding `is_round_trip` + `return_departure_at`). Surface `checkout_url` once the user picked this flight; `search_results_url` while comparing.\n- rail: an `explicit/train` deeplink. TWO modes. (1) Seat page (default): inputs `departure_geo_point_id`, `arrival_geo_point_id`, `train_number`, `departure_at` (ISO) — the link opens the train\'s order page where the user picks seats. (2) Straight-to-cart (`kind="checkout_deeplink"`): additionally pass the seat choice — `car_number` + `seat_numbers` (from `get_rail_seatmap`: `cars[].car_number`, `seats[].number`; one seat per passenger) plus `offer_hash` + `segment_hash` from `checkout_ref` — and the link mints the cart with those exact seats pre-selected (works in a cold browser; the cart belongs to whoever OPENS the link). Optional: `fare_type` (the chosen `fares[].fare_type` from the seatmap, e.g. REFUNDABLE), `gender_type` (for gender-policy coupes: MALE/FEMALE — ask the user; omit for regular cars), and `search_id`/`result_id`/`card_id` metadata from `checkout_ref`. Use straight-to-cart ONLY after the user explicitly confirmed specific seats; the cart skips the seat wizard, so a silently wrong seat would go unnoticed. Falls back to the tutu.ru/poezda/order page (needs `departure_city_id`, `arrival_city_id`, `departure_station_code`, `arrival_station_code`) if the deeplink can\'t be built.\n- bus: an `explicit/bus` deeplink. TWO modes, same idea. (1) Seat page (default): `offer_hash`, `departure_geo_city_id`, `arrival_geo_city_id`, `departure_at` (ISO). (2) Straight-to-cart: additionally `seat_numbers` (from `get_offer_details`\'s `seat_selection.available_seat_ids`; one per passenger) + `search_id` + `departure_id`/`arrival_id` (all REQUIRED here — pass them through from `checkout_ref`). Falls back to the bus.tutu.ru/seats page (`departure_id`, `arrival_id`, `city_from`, `city_to`) otherwise.\n- etrain: tutu.ru schedule page from `departure_etrain_id`, `arrival_etrain_id`, `departure_at`.\n- hotels: an `explicit/hotel` deeplink.
